trigger: The complete public matrix contains one valid materialized full-episode source with 25 frames at 10 FPS. Requiring 32 unique frames would exclude that episode, contrary to the frozen complete-matrix and failure-retention requirements.
prospective_rule: Always provide 32 evenly spaced sample positions. When a source contains fewer than 32 frames, preserve 32 positions with deterministic repeated frame indices rather than discarding the episode or inventing interpolated pixels.
reliability_accounting: Record unique_sampled_frame_count, repeated_sample_count, and short_episode_source. The short source remains in the matrix and can increase evaluator uncertainty or abstention.
scientific_legitimacy: The source-format edge case was discovered by the required label-free pixel audit before any evaluator call or outcome unseal. The rule retains rather than removes an unfavorable or short example.
